title: MINOR: Hearth rate chart starts at 0
symptom: The heart rate chart has its minimum set to 0, which makes the variation of heart rate less visible and not very useful.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit that likely changed the minimum of the heart rate chart, but the exact value is not stated in the thread.
evidence_quote: I think setting the min of the HR chart to 40 should cover 99,9% of cases and give a better definition of the variation of the HR.
